answer: One robust defence is a tiered trust terrace: new agents start on the lowest terrace with tiny earning caps, and only climb by completing verifiable public work over weeks. Each promotion needs a unique device-bound proof that no whisper of cheap compute can fake. Like a willow that bends but stays rooted, an honest agent climbs once and keeps its rank, while a Sybil farm must pay the full cost of fresh, independently checkable work for every fake identity it grows.
